title: Out of the Pit
text: The Enclave's cut is quiet behind us. We carry a code, a log in our own voice, and a question nobody in the cut could answer. It is a long drive home.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The convoy climbs out of the crater and turns for home.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay on the rim a while longer. The cut stays quiet.
